name: Refract
author: Lewis Buckley
description: Multi-color theme sync for RGB hardware and Philips Hue. Builds a gradient from the active Omarchy theme's palette and spreads it across every LED of every device OpenRGB sees and every color-capable Hue light, with live state in the bar.

barWidget.description: Theme-palette gradients across your RGB devices and Philips Hue lights, per LED. Dots in the bar show the live gradient; the panel lists every device with its colors, and lets you re-apply, exclude, or switch devices off.

schema.label: Follow the theme
schema.description: Re-apply the gradient whenever the Omarchy theme changes.

schema.label: Style
schema.description: "gradient" interpolates through the anchor colors across each device's LEDs; "solid" sends only the first anchor.

schema.label: Vivid colors on devices
schema.description: LEDs render mid-saturation colors as washed out, so hardware colors are sent with lifted saturation. Turn off to send the exact theme colors.

schema.label: Anchor colors
schema.description: colors.toml keys the gradient passes through, in order. Keys a theme does not define are skipped.

schema.label: Sync Philips Hue lights
schema.description: Find the Hue bridge on the local network and set every color-capable light from the theme gradient. Pairing needs one press of the bridge's link button.

schema.label: Hue bridge address
schema.description: IP address or hostname of the Hue bridge. Leave blank to discover it.

schema.label: Hue room or zone
schema.description: Sync only the lights in this room or zone, by the name shown in the Hue app. Leave blank for every color-capable light.

schema.label: Start the OpenRGB server when none is running
schema.description: Launches `openrgb --server` once per session if nothing answers on the SDK port.
